# Wi-Fi protocol host fixtures

All XML, CSV and HTTP envelopes in `WifiS5Checks.java` are independently authored
minimal fixtures under this repository's MIT license. `preview.jpg` and
`original.jpg` are generated by our own `tools/s5-wifi/mock_camera.py` grayscale
JPEG encoder (no camera image, third-party JPEG or packet capture).

These fixtures exercise parsing, once-only dispatch, catalog pagination and
selection, UDP rejection, cancellation and atomic downloads. They do not verify
DC-S5 firmware 2.9 or its application packet framing. Gen2 samples are envelopes
only; no response algorithm or G9II constants are included.
